title: mocon execution record
description: core.md section 5.2. Key (host, "execution", id). A line without end is a start notice; a line with end is a complete record and carries every field the record will ever have.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339, UTC, trailing Z, up to nine fractional digits (core.md section 7).

session.description: Open string: host-defined grouping under which executions are related.

traceparent.description: W3C traceparent string (version-traceid-parentid-flags, e.g. 00-<32 hex>-<16 hex>-<2 hex>), relayed from the caller unmodified and unverified (core.md section 5.2). Not pattern-constrained here: core.md requires the host to copy the value as received, including a malformed or future-version header, so a schema pattern would reject records core.md requires a host to emit. See otel-mapping.md section 4.1 for how a sink treats a malformed value.

outputs.description: Maps channel name to Payload. Recommended names: stdout, stderr, logs, files.

oneOf.title: start notice
oneOf.description: No end. Optional. Carries the fields known when the record began.

oneOf.title: complete record
oneOf.description: Carries end. It has every field the record will ever have. A host emits it exactly once.
